newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen shares end sharply lower on Deng health.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen shares end sharply lower on Deng health.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index ended sharply lower on Tuesday with rumours about the health of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping dampening market sentiment, brokers said.
The B share index lost 14.59 points or 9.58 percent to 137.72 on volume of 28.5 million shares worth HK$152.6 million.
The A share index was down 36.53 points or 9.76 percent to 337.6 on volume of 782.1 million shares worth 8.5 billion yuan.
Foreign media reports said China's Communist Party chief Jiang Zemin and other leaders had cut short out-of-town trips to visit the ailing patriarch.
China's Foreign Ministry said on Tuesday there had been no major change in the health of 92-year-old paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.

"Investors lost confidence as a result of foreign media reports on Deng's health," an analyst with a major Chinese brokerage said. "I expect most investors to stay on the sidelines until the situation is clarified."

Jiang, who is also president and army chief, returned to Beijing at the weekend, cutting short a visit to the southeastern province of Jiangxi, foreign media reports quoted a Chinese source close to the party as saying.
Premier Li Peng also curtailed a trip to the southern province of Guangdong and flew back to the capital at the weekend, the reports quoted an unidentified source as saying.

"Sentiment was severely soured by today's across-the-board plunges and is unlikely to recover immediately," a broker said. "There is no reason other than fears over Deng's health that could drive share prices down so sharply."
On the B share market, Jiangling Motors Corporation Ltd hits its 10 percent limit-down, falling HK$0.35 to HK$3.12 on volume of 461,100 shares.
Hefei Meilin Co Ltd followed suit, closed down HK$0.58 at HK$5.23 on the day's heaviest trade of 2.15 million shares.
Market leader, Chongqing Changan Automobile Co Ltd fell HK$0.46 to HK$4.11 with 1.76 million shares changing hands.
On the A share market, automobile parts maker Zhuzhou Torch Car Spark Plug Co Ltd, one of the biggest loser, fell 0.51 yuan or 10 percent to 4.55 yuan on volume of 3.47 million shares.
